rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining capped below the 5-minute 9-EMA (now $18.87) for immediate downside continuation after a high-volume breakdown. Instead, over the past 23 minutes downside follow-through has stalled, and the last three 1-minute candles show consecutive higher highs and higher closes culminating in a reclaim of the 9-EMA at $18.94 on expanding volume (29,740 shares). With the key dynamic resistance broken and short-term momentum shifting upward against the position, exiting now reduces loss before the $19.12 hard invalidation is tested.
